prompt: What does a `+server.js` file export?

choices.text: A list of the addresses it answers
choices.why: The folder is the address.

choices.text: One function per HTTP method, such as `GET`
choices.why: Right: each returns a `Response`.

choices.text: A component, rendered without a layout
choices.why: Nothing is rendered in an endpoint.

choices.text: A `load` function and an `actions` object
choices.why: Those belong in `+page.server.js`.

prompt: Which folder gives an endpoint the address `/planner.json`?
hint: The dot is part of the name.

choices.text: `src/routes/(api)/planner/`
choices.why: That answers `/planner`; a group adds nothing.

choices.text: `src/routes/planner/`
choices.why: That answers `/planner`, with no `.json`.

choices.text: `static/planner.json/`
choices.why: `static` holds files served as they are, not routes.

choices.text: `src/routes/planner.json/`
choices.why: Right: the folder's name is the last part of the address.

prompt: Why did `/planner.json` carry the three headers from lesson 16?
hint: Layouts do not apply to endpoints. Something else does.

choices.text: `handle` runs for endpoints as it does for pages
choices.why: Right: every request the server answers passes through it.

choices.text: The root layout adds them to every route
choices.why: Layouts have no effect on `+server.js`.

choices.text: `json()` writes them into every response it makes
choices.why: `json()` sets only the body and `Content-Type`.

choices.text: The dev server sends them, and a build would not
choices.why: That is true of `Vary: Origin` only.

prompt: What does lesson 13's warning mean for an endpoint?

choices.text: It runs in the browser as well as on the server
choices.why: An endpoint runs on the server only.

choices.text: It can only be reached from the application's own pages
choices.why: Anything that knows the address can ask.

choices.text: Whoever reaches the address can read what it returns
choices.why: Right: a check of who is asking has to come first.

choices.text: Its data has to be serializable with devalue
choices.why: It returns a `Response`; devalue is for load data.

prompt: What does `Content-Disposition: attachment` ask the browser to do?

choices.text: Show the file as a table in the page
choices.why: It asks for the opposite of showing.

choices.text: Attach the file to the next form it sends
choices.why: It is about the response, not the next request.

choices.text: Save the file, under the name given
choices.why: Right: `filename` names it.

choices.text: Open the file in a spreadsheet
choices.why: What opens it later is up to the person.

prompt: Match each value with how `cell()` writes it.
Why does a cell starting with `=` get an apostrophe in front?
hint: Think of what a spreadsheet does with `=`.

choices.text: So a spreadsheet shows it as text instead of running it
choices.why: Right: that is the usual defence against CSV injection.

choices.text: Because the CSV format forbids an `=` at the start of a cell value
choices.why: The format allows it; spreadsheets act on it.

choices.text: To keep a comma inside the cell from splitting it into two cells
choices.why: Quotes do that, the other rule.

choices.text: So that the browser saves the file rather than open it
choices.why: That is `Content-Disposition`.

prompt: What does `download` on the link change?
hint: Two things: the browser and the router.

choices.text: It makes the server send a smaller file, compressed before it leaves
choices.why: The server sends the same bytes.

choices.text: It limits the file to this week's sessions
choices.why: The file holds every session of the course.

choices.text: It makes SvelteKit fetch the file as a client-side navigation instead
choices.why: The router leaves such links alone.

choices.text: The browser saves the file; the router ignores the click
choices.why: Right: the browser handles the link.

prompt: Why does the check move into `src/lib/server/check.js`?

choices.text: Actions are not allowed to validate
choices.why: They can; the action still uses the check.

choices.text: So the form and the endpoint share one rule
choices.why: Right: a rule written twice drifts apart.

choices.text: So the browser can check sessions too
choices.why: It is under `server`, so the browser never gets it.

choices.text: Because the endpoint cannot import from a route
choices.why: The reason is one rule, not imports.

prompt: Match each status the planner answers with to its cause.
What status does `/api/sessions` answer with when it adds a session?
Why does the endpoint check `Content-Type` before reading the body?
hint: What can a form on another site send?

choices.text: A forged `text/plain` form reads as JSON to `request.json()`
choices.why: Right: without the check, that forged form would be read and saved.

choices.text: SvelteKit can check it in dev, but not in a build
choices.why: Its own check is in a build; this one is everywhere.

choices.text: `request.json()` throws when the header is missing
choices.why: It parses whatever text arrives.

choices.text: Browsers refuse to send JSON to an endpoint without it
choices.why: The danger is a form that is not JSON at all.

prompt: The endpoint copies three fields from the body: `course`, `date` and ___.
`curl` asks for `/courses/guitar` with `Accept: application/json`. Which file answers?
hint: It does not ask for HTML.

choices.text: `+page.svelte`
choices.why: The page answers requests that prefer HTML.

choices.text: `+page.server.js`
choices.why: That holds the actions, for `POST`s.

choices.text: `+server.js`
choices.why: Right: its `GET` returns the course as JSON.

choices.text: `+page.js`
choices.why: A load function never answers a request by itself.

prompt: Why does the JSON response carry `vary: Accept`?
hint: Think of a cache between the two.

choices.text: Because lesson 16's hook adds it
choices.why: SvelteKit adds it, not the hook.

choices.text: So caches keep the JSON and the HTML apart
choices.why: Right: otherwise one could be handed to whoever asked for the other.

choices.text: So the browser asks again in a different format
choices.why: It is about caching, not asking again.

choices.text: To tell the browser the body is JSON
choices.why: `Content-Type` says that.

prompt: Why do the course page's forms still work with a `+server.js` beside it?

choices.text: The endpoint forwards each `POST` it receives on to the page's actions
choices.why: It has only a `GET`, and forwards nothing.

choices.text: Forms switch to sending `GET` once an endpoint is in the folder
choices.why: They still send `POST`.

choices.text: `use:enhance` is switched off on that page
choices.why: The capture used it, and it worked.

choices.text: A browser form prefers HTML; `use:enhance` flags its own
choices.why: Right: both reach the actions.

prompt: Which requests to `/courses/guitar` reach `+server.js`? Choose all that apply.
hint: The ones that do not prefer HTML.

choices.text: `GET` with `Accept: application/json`
choices.why: Yes: it asks for JSON.

choices.text: `GET` from `curl` with no `Accept` of its own
choices.why: Yes: `*/*` does not prefer HTML.

choices.text: `GET` from a browser opening the page
choices.why: It prefers HTML, so the page answers.

choices.text: `POST` from the form with JavaScript off
choices.why: It prefers HTML and reaches the action.

prompt: What did `curl` get for `/courses/piano/sessions.csv`?

choices.text: An empty CSV file with only the header row
choices.why: The endpoint stopped at `error(404, …)`.

choices.text: A redirect to the week page
choices.why: Nothing redirects there.

choices.text: The planner's error page, with the header
choices.why: `+error.svelte` is never used for an endpoint.

choices.text: The 404 as JSON, with its message
choices.why: Right: `{"status":404,"message":…}`.

prompt: Match each job with what the planner uses for it.
hint: A form on a page is one thing; everything else is the other.

pairs.left: Adding a session from the course page
A script that imports sessions as JSON

prompt: Which row of the table is the same for actions and endpoints?

choices.text: An error
choices.why: One shows `+error.svelte`, the other answers data.

choices.text: Hooks
choices.why: Right: `handle` runs for both.

choices.text: Works with JavaScript off
choices.why: Only the form is sure to.

choices.text: Layouts
choices.why: `+layout` files have no effect on an endpoint.

prompt: A calendar app should read each course's sessions from the planner. What do you write?
hint: A program, not a person, is asking.

choices.text: A form action on the course page
choices.why: Actions are for the application's own forms.

choices.text: A `+page.js` that returns the sessions
choices.why: A load function feeds a page, not another program.

choices.text: A `GET` in a `+server.js` under the course's folder
choices.why: Right: an endpoint, like the CSV one.

choices.text: A hook that answers every calendar request
choices.why: A hook is for every request, not one route.

prompt: You add a third way to create sessions. Where does its check of minutes come from?

choices.text: `problemWith` from `#lib/server/check.js`
choices.why: Right: the same one the form and the endpoint use.

choices.text: A copy of the two `if`s from lesson 14
choices.why: A second copy is a rule that drifts.

choices.text: The `min` and `max` on the form's inputs
choices.why: Those are the browser's, and anything can skip them.

choices.text: Nothing: `addSession` checks the minutes itself
choices.why: It checks only that the course exists.
